# Yeahboy App

> Yeahboy App is a funny macOS sound app for Mac and MacBook. It gives a Mac a personality by playing sound reactions for everyday hardware and system events.

Official website: https://yeahboy.app/
Direct download: https://yeahboy.app/Yeahboy-1.0.2.dmg
Platform: macOS
System requirement: macOS 14.0 or later
Current version: 1.0
Support: hello@yeahboy.app

## What Yeahboy App does

- Plays a selected sound when a charger is connected or disconnected.
- Plays a selected sound when the MacBook lid opens or closes.
- Reacts to screen lock and authentication events.
- Detects taps on supported Mac hardware using motion sensor data.
- Lets users choose a different sound for each trigger.
- Runs from a lightning bolt control in the macOS menu bar.

## Installation

1. Download the Yeahboy DMG from the official website.
2. Open the disk image.
3. Drag YeahBoi into the Applications folder.
4. Open YeahBoi from Applications.

## Canonical description

Yeahboy App for Mac is a lightweight macOS sound effects utility that reacts to charging, lid movement, screen lock, authentication, and physical taps.
